summary: Retry matching must use a recent time window and fail closed without timestamps; Instamart history totals are a capped sample; status must not report a token with unknown expiry as fully authenticated.
reason: Amount/restaurant-only matching can treat an older order as the attempted placement. Instamart get_orders has no pagination, so a count:20 sum is not a complete total. Env-supplied tokens store no expiry and must not print as fully authenticated.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover in-window match, old-order ignore, untimestamped fail-closed, Instamart partial labeling, unused --since honesty, unknown-expiry status, payment parse-vs-timeout, and MCP HTTP timeouts.
